children: Gina Martin Adams, strategist at HB Wealth

"We're probably going to see tech continue to struggle to absorb this giant amount of issuance...I think the market is putting too much pressure on this company as indicative of AI appetite. The reality is it's a giant IPO and giant IPOs kind of behave the same."
Mohamed A. El-Erian, former CEO of PIMCO and Wharton School professor

"Remember this isn't just about the promise of AI, but about making room for it. In a narrow sense, investor financing of the mega-IPO involves making room by selling other holdings. In a broader sense, it mirrors what we have been seeing with yields: with no large borrowers reducing their use of the bond market, financing costs rise for everyone, hitting rate-sensitive sectors particularly hard."

"I think the market seriously underestimated just how much liquidity Anthropic's IPO would require...The question isn't whether investors want exposure to AI. It's whether the market has sufficient liquidity to absorb this much supply without forcing liquidation elsewhere."
